title: selaginella densa var. standleyi
intro: Selaginella densa var. standleyi, commonly known as Mexican spikemoss, is a type of terrestrial fern-like plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, respiratory issues, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Mexican spikemoss include its ability to modulate immune response, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antipyretic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which have been shown to have potential therapeutic applications in various fields of medicine.
